FEATURED WALKTHROUGH · BANGLA

Create your own personal website with Wishly.

A step-by-step video for people who want to make a personal birthday, proposal, anniversary or other special-moment website without writing code.

Watch on this page or open the tutorial on YouTube ↗.

What this walkthrough helps you understand

  1. Choose an occasion.Start with the kind of moment you want to celebrate.
  2. Pick a suitable template.Review the design and its supported editable sections.
  3. Personalize the page.Add your own text, photos and supported media.
  4. Preview the experience.Check the layout and content on a mobile screen.
  5. Publish and share.Test the final link before sending it to someone.
